spec.description: EcoDorm capstone: live ESP32 DHT22 and PMS5003 telemetry, operational status, device freshness, and trends. Validated with actual Node-RED/InfluxDB deployment; prototype thresholds are not regulatory health limits.

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature" and r.device_id == "temp01")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

options.content:
# EcoDorm | Indoor Environmental Monitoring
**Real-Time ESP32 Telemetry · Edge–Cloud Monitoring · Automated Alerts**

| Sensor metric | 🟢 NORMAL | 🟠 WARNING | 🔴 CRITICAL |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **Temperature** (°C) | ≤ 32 | > 32 to 36 | > 36 |
| **Humidity** (%) | ≤ 75 | > 75 to 85 | > 85 |
| **PM2.5** (µg/m³) | ≤ 35 | > 35 to 75 | > 75 |

*Prototype rules from Node-RED, applied to individual sensor readings. They are not regulatory air-quality limits.*

spec.title: DHT22 · Device Health
spec.description: ONLINE: telemetry received <180 s ago. OFFLINE: ≥180 s ago. UNKNOWN: no telemetry in the last 30 days. Calculated from InfluxDB, not an ICMP/ping check.

spec.query:
import "array"

lastSeen = from(bucket: "ecodorm_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ecodorm_sensors")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature" and r.device_id == "temp01")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: now(),
    _field: "last_seen_seconds",
    _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0
  }))

unknown = array.from(rows: [{
  _time: now(),
  _field: "last_seen_seconds",
  _value: -1.0
}])

union(tables: [lastSeen, unknown])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> max(column: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

spec.title: Temperature Trend
spec.description: Mean of available telemetry windows (no artificial empty buckets). Disconnect at gaps >= 180 seconds to indicate a possible outage.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ecodorm_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ecodorm_sensors")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature" and r.device_id == "temp01")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
